name: Bisil Plast Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1986, Bisil Plast Ltd manufactures PET bottles, jars and ancillary products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company is in the business of dealing in PET bottles, Jars and its ancillary product through wholesale supply to Pharmaceutical companies, FMCG Companies, bottling companies, etc. 
Company has identified supplier of PET bottles and Jars manufacturers and have initiated the process and executed agreement to acquire PET bottles and Jars

cons: Stock is trading at 38.9 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -5.59% over past five years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.55 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 283 days.
Working capital days have increased from 141 days to 318 days
